title: SGLang /server_info -- T1552 admin-api-key-only config returns API keys and SSL keyfile paths
author: WinstonRedGuard -- sigma plugin observed rules (derived from breach corpus)
description:
Vendor-disclosed detection for CVE-2026-15977 (GHSA-jx7q-p32r-7wx8,
CVSS 7.5 HIGH), affecting SGLang.

The `/server_info` diagnostic endpoint returns API keys and SSL
keyfile information in its response when a deployment is configured
with ONLY `--admin-api-key` set (a common configuration for
admin-gated deployments that otherwise expect the regular inference
API to remain open or separately secured). The endpoint's information
disclosure was not gated on the same admin credential it was meant to
protect, so a caller who can reach `/server_info` at all -- not
necessarily one holding the admin key -- receives secrets that should
never leave the server process.

Detection logic flags a response from `/server_info` whose body
contains fields recognizable as API-key or keyfile-path material
-- the exact leak surface this advisory describes, distinct from the
endpoint's intended (non-secret) diagnostic content.

Aggregated from 2 independent sources (SGLang's own GHSA advisory + an
independent security researcher's corroborating disclosure write-up,
part of the same coordinated multi-CVE SGLang research series as the
sibling execution rules above), no patched version confirmed in the
summary available at authoring time.
